  ga: null  # The person's latest General Assembly; null = CURRENT_GA

```{r}
# Career page: the person's latest session in full (ga), their electoral
# history, and links to archived pages for earlier sessions. Renders to
# docs/legislators/, one directory below docs/.
up <- 1
```

{{< include _legislator_data.qmd >}}

```{r}
# Electoral history comes from the elections domain (data + markup)
source(here::here("R/elections/ui_helpers.R"))

# Every race matched to this person, plus links to other legislators' pages
# (opponents, previous seat holders)
election_results <- load_legislative_results()
races <- legislator_races(params$people_id, election_results, legislator$party)
legislator_href <- \(id) {
  if (id %in% people_full$people_id) paste0(get_legislator_filename(id, people_full), ".html") else NULL
}

# Earlier sessions, each with an archived page under docs/legislators/ga{N}/
past_sessions <- legislator_sessions() |>
  filter(people_id == params$people_id, ga < !!ga) |>
  arrange(desc(ga))
career_filename <- get_legislator_filename(params$people_id, people_full)

district_extra <- tagList(ui_latest_result(races), elections_tab_script())
```

:::

```{r}
# Earlier sessions: one row each, linking to the archived session page
if (nrow(past_sessions) > 0) {
  past_rows <- past_sessions |>
    mutate(
      session = map(ga, \(g) a(href = paste0(ga_slug(g), "/", career_filename, ".html"),
                               paste0(ga_label(g), " (", ga_years(g), ")"))),
      role = if_else(role == "Sen", "Senator", "Representative"),
      bills_sponsored = map_int(ga, \(g) {
        sum(read_csv(ga_csv("sponsors", g), col_select = people_id, show_col_types = FALSE)$people_id ==
              params$people_id)
      })
    ) |>
    select(session, role, district, bills_sponsored)
  div(class = "ia-card",
    div(class = "ia-card-title", "Earlier sessions"),
    ui_table(past_rows,
             labels = c(session = "Session", role = "Role", district = "District",
                        bills_sponsored = "Bills sponsored"),
             numeric = "bills_sponsored", nowrap = "district")
  )
}
```

::: {.ia-sources}
Profile generated from LegiScan data for the Iowa Legislature; election results from the Iowa Secretary of State. Last updated `r format(Sys.Date(), "%B %e, %Y") |> str_squish()`
:::
